items.title: Prohibited and Sanctioned Countries
items.description: It was noted that Netherlands and sanctioned countries are allowed to register. Remove with immediate effect.
items.notes: 09/23/2025: Applicant`s reply: "Dear GCB Team, Thank you for reaching out to us regarding your recent access to the pledoo.com and betitall.com websites from the Netherlands. Please be assured that all necessary measures have been implemented to prevent access from Dutch IP addresses. We have thoroughly reviewed both platforms and can confirm that access from the Netherlands is entirely restricted. Furthermore, this access restriction is managed not only by our team but also enforced by our platform providers, ensuring that users from prohibited jurisdictions cannot access or register on our sites. To assist us in investigating this matter further, we kindly request that you provide a screenshot and a link to the page you were able to access. This information will allow us to examine the issue from our end and gain further insight into your experience. We are also aware of recent schemes involving unauthorized mirror sites or fake domains that purport to enable access from restricted countries. We appreciate your assistance in helping us maintain compliance and security. Sincerely, Momus2006 N.V. Team". 09/23/2025: I acknowledge remediation of the item by the applicant (visiting both domains). 09/23/2025: Account Manager: GC. to be tested during AML audit and confirmed again,
